text: Vaccines are tested for safety and effectiveness before they are approved for public use.
Climate change refers to long-term shifts in temperatures and weather patterns, mainly caused by human activities since the 1800s.
The Earth is the third planet from the Sun and is the only astronomical object known to harbor life.
Regular physical activity can provide health benefits and can reduce the risk of several chronic diseases.
Water boils at approximately 100 degrees Celsius at standard atmospheric pressure.
The Moon is Earth's only natural satellite.
Photosynthesis allows green plants to convert light energy into chemical energy.
The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest ocean on Earth.
Artificial intelligence systems can process data and identify patterns to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence.
Misinformation is false or inaccurate information that is shared regardless of an intention to deceive.
Earth is an approximately spherical planet, slightly flattened at the poles and wider at the equator.
Earth's Moon is 3.7 times smaller than Earth, with an equatorial radius of about 1,737.5 km compared with Earth's 6,371 km.
The Moon is a rocky, layered world with a core, mantle, and crust; its mantle and crust contain minerals and rock-forming elements.
